SqlServerCertificateValidationErrors.summary: Specifies server certificate validation errors observed by the driver. This enumeration supports a bitwise combination of its member values.
SqlServerCertificateValidationErrors.remarks: Reported by . A value for that property means validation did not run or the outcome is not available; means validation ran and no errors were observed.

None.summary: Certificate validation ran and no errors were observed.

ServerCertificateMissing.summary: The server did not present a certificate.

HostNameMismatch.summary: The certificate presented by the server does not match the expected host name.

ChainError.summary: The certificate chain could not be built or validated. See for details.

PinnedCertificateMismatch.summary: The certificate presented by the server does not match the certificate configured with the ServerCertificate connection string keyword.
